g.title: Sheet.1289
g.desc: ROUTER: “If I am to handle millions of packets per second, I ...
g.text: ROUTER: “If I am to handle millions of packets per second, I need to know exactly where to find the source and destination IPs. I don’t have time to open each packet and read every header.”

g.title: Sheet.1290
g.text: The router only reads the headers in green
